name: Telegram Per Project
description:
Telegram channel for Claude Code with per-project bot isolation. Each project gets its own Telegram bot, access policy, and message inbox — so messages to @alpha_bot reach Terminal 1 and messages to @beta_bot reach Terminal 2, with no cross-talk. 

Key features:                                                                                           
  - Per-project bot tokens via TELEGRAM_PROJECT_ID environment variable
  - Independent access policies per project, bootstrapped from global config
  - Response timeout — notifies senders when the assistant isn't responding (configurable, default 45s)
  - Full access control: DM pairing, allowlists, group mention detection                                  
  - Reply, react, and edit_message tools for the assistant                                                
  - Photo support with inline preview                                                                     
  - Fully backward compatible — works as a single global bot if no project ID is set
longDescription:
Ships **2 skills**, **1 hook** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (2): `access` (Manage Telegram channel access — approve pairings, edit allowlists, set DM/group policy), `configure` (Set up the Telegram channel — save the bot token and review access policy)
- **Hooks** (1): `SessionStart`
- **MCP servers** (1): `telegram`

Installs with `claude plugin install telegram-per-project@claude-community` from `trezero/telegram-per-project`.
